name: Marketplace Integration for Shopee & Lazada
author: cedcommerce

sections.description:
Get your hands on the next-gen multichannel selling experience with this Shopee and Lazada integration for WooCommerce. This integration enables you to sell on Shopee and Lazada marketplaces from a single dashboard!

Experience powerful features like real-time data syncing, automated inventory management, and simplified order management to save time and scale your business.

Sell on Shopee and Lazada from a single integration. Access real-time data syncing, simplified inventory, and order management to scale your business.

Save your money and efforts by selling across two of the leading SEA marketplaces – Shopee and Lazada.

Enhance your selling operations and scale your business

  • Real-time syncing of products & orders
  • Dedicated marketplace dashboards
  • Bulk product management across Shopee & Lazada
  • Manage Shopee & Lazade orders on the WooCommerce store
  • Pricing rules & currency conversion to ensure profits
  • Sales & data analytics that help you make informed sales strategies

Benefits of the Shopee & Lazada Integration

Save your money and efforts by selling across two of the leading SEA marketplaces – Shopee and Lazada. The best part about this integration is that you don’t have to pay extra charges.

  • Real-time sync for products and orders – Keep your inventory and sales updated across platforms instantly.

  • Centralized marketplace dashboards – Manage all your marketplace activities from one unified interface.

  • Bulk product management for Shopee & Lazada – Easily upload, edit, and organize products in bulk across multiple marketplaces.

  • Manage Shopee & Lazada orders in WooCommerce – Seamlessly handle marketplace orders directly from your WooCommerce store.

  • Import products with ease – Import and sync hundreds of Shopee and Lazada products to your WooCommerce store within minutes.

  • Pricing rules with currency conversion – Ensure profitability with automated price adjustments across different currencies.

  • Sales analytics for smarter strategies – Use data-driven insights to optimize your sales and grow your business.

External API

This plugin uses external API (https://api.cedcommerce.com/(endpoint), https://subscriptions.cedcommerce.com/pricing/(endpoint)) to facilitate seamless integration with Shopee & Lazada.The API enables advanced features such as managing product listings, order synchronization. For more information about the API, please visit Cedcommerce Privacy Policy Page (https://cedcommerce.com/privacy-policy).

Use cases

✅ **Don’t want auto inventory syncing** If you want to manage your inventory manually across Shopee, Lazada, and WooCommerce, the plugin provides that feasibility.
✅ **Currency conversion** You can enter your desired currency conversion value and the plugin will convert the same for all product listings.
✅ **Submitting tracking details to customers** With the Shopee and Lazada integration for WooCommerce, you can send order tracking details to the customers.
✅ **Shipping and Fulfillment** The plugin seamlessly integrates with multiple fulfillment shipping carriers on different channels to help you track and monitor orders.
✅ **Using another plugin for fulfillment** This multichannel integration also supports mapping shipping attributes from any other WooCommerce plugin you use.

sections.installation:
Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option as WordPress handles the file transfers itself and you don’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install of Product Auto Share, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click Add New.

In the search field type “Wholesale Market” and click Search Plugins. Once you’ve found our Wholesale Market plugin you can view details about it such as the point release, rating and description. Most importantly of course, you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now”.

Manual installation

The manual installation method involves downloading our Wholesale Market plugin and uploading it to your webserver via your favourite FTP application. The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to do this here.

Updating

Automatic updates should work like a charm; as always though, ensure you backup your site just in case.
sections.faq:
Aren’t there any hidden charges while using this integration?

The pricing plans for the Shopee and Lazada integration for WooCommerce are transparent and fixed. You enjoy the benefits of selling across two marketplaces cost-effectively.

What do I need to get started with the multichannel integration for Shopee & Lazada?

To get started with the Shopee and Lazada integration for WooCommerce, you need to ensure that you have an active WooCommerce store and marketplace storefronts for Shopee and Lazada.

Is it safe to synchronize my inventory, orders, and other data via the Shopee & Lazada plugin for WooCommerce?

Each CedCommerce plugin complies with the Encryption Protocol and follows the latest iteration of Transport Layer Security (TLS 1.3) and robust AES 256 encryption. This means that every data in transit across channels via the plugin is absolutely safe.
